threads.title: Can AI Agent Swarms Make Onchain Work More Reliable?
threads.body:
I've been exploring the idea behind SIMD and its AI agent swarm, and I think one of the most interesting aspects is how multiple agents can work together to complete tasks.

The concept of having agents handle different parts of a job, with verification to check the final output, could make AI-powered work more useful and transparent.

A few things I'm curious about:

- How is the quality of completed tasks verified?
- Can users track an agent's performance and reliability over time?
- What opportunities will there be for community members to contribute to the ecosystem?

I believe the real potential lies not just in generating AI outputs, but in making the entire process more reliable, verifiable, and useful.

Curious to hear what the community thinks. What use case would you most like to see SIMD tackle first?
